_meta.version: v4 D.G fixtures (shapes B + C + D, D via Option-Z + post-processor)
_meta.purpose: Lean artifacts for v4 binary compare (B) and control (C) claims. Shape D (implicit direction) requires Option W sigma-Bool kernel pattern — pipeline.py extension TBD; once landed, add D-shape fixtures.
_meta.options_used: Z fallback for now: ArgmaxWhere with Cond.or disjunction for B; HasProperty for C-lookup; SumWhere with Cond.or for C-sum. Option W replaces D-shape ArgminWhere/HasProperty pattern with a kernel-checked sigma-Bool.
_meta.d_shape_note: Shape-D entries reuse the shape-B Option-Z ArgmaxWhere formalization (same table, same entity pair, same measure column) and add fields subject_entity / direction_if_subject_{wins,loses}. At evaluation time the post-processor maps the kernel-verified winning entity to the direction word: if witness matches subject_entity, answer = direction_if_subject_wins; else direction_if_subject_loses.
